item.title: D4vd Charged with Murder | Case by Case
item.description: Following the discovery of Celeste Rivas Hernandez's remains in a vehicle registered to D4vd last fall, what were the key developments that led to charges this week? On this episode of "Case by Case," we examine all of the new details coming out of the case against singer-songwriter David Anthony Burke, who professionally goes by D4vd. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales and CBS News chief correspondent Matt Gutman break down what we know so far about Celeste's death and the alleged abusive relationship she had with the singer.

item.title: Inside the Sentencing of the Gilgo Beach Serial Killer | Case by Case
item.description: After decades of waiting, the victims of Gilgo Beach serial killer Rex Heuermann finally faced him in a courtroom that became a space for grief, rage, and release. In this episode, we focus on the emotional heart of the sentencing — from raw statements to the quiet devastation of children who grew up without their mothers — and what it meant to finally say these words, face-to-face.

item.title: Watch Live: Second psychiatric nurse practitioner testifies at Lindsay Clancy trial
item.description: Testimony at the Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Massachusetts will resume Tuesday with testimony from a second psychiatric nurse practitioner.

item.title: Wisconsin's Democratic showdown and more primary races to watch today
item.description: South Carolina Republicans will be choosing a successor for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham's seat, and Minnesota's Senate primary is another battle between moderate and progressive Democrats.

item.title: Here's how much interest a $60,000 high-yield savings account will earn in one year
item.description: Thinking of transferring $60,000 into a high-yield savings account? Here's how much interest you could earn if you do.

item.title: U.S. and Iran close to "peace arrangement or a deal," Pakistan says
item.description: The U.S. and Iran are close to agreeing on "some sort of arrangement," Pakistan's defense minister told Bloomberg on Tuesday.

item.title: Key Senate primary in Minnesota could help decide future of Democratic party
item.description: In Minnesota, a crucial Democratic Senate primary could help to determine the party's future path. Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan, a progressive, and Rep. Angie Craig, a moderate, will face off Tuesday. Jonah Kaplan reports.

item.title: 3 tubers in Michigan, including a child, rescued after days without food or water
item.description: Three tubers who got lost along Michigan's Muskegon River were rescued last week. They were missing for three days in the woods and didn't have food or water. Meg Oliver reports.

item.title: 5 takeaways from Zuckerberg's essay on his vision for superintelligence
item.description: In a 6,500-word post, the Meta CEO argues that superintelligence should be shared "with as many people and businesses as possible."

item.title: Wildfires incinerate homes and ecosystems in the western U.S. and Canada
item.description: A heavy fire season is slamming the western U.S. and Canada, with flames devastating homes and spurring evacuations across many communities. CBS News' Ian Lee has more details.

item.title: Election races to keep an eye on with primaries underway in six states
item.description: Voters in six states will cast their ballots in today's primaries. CBS News' Fin Gómez and Taurean Small have the latest on key races.

item.title: Lifeguard recalls escaping shark's grasp as officials warn of attacks closer to shore
item.description: A lifeguard says a shark dragged him about 5 feet underwater off the coast of Scarborough Beach in Maine before he was able to escape and emerge unharmed. The attack comes as officials along the East Coast say there are more sharks closer to shore in areas where they don't usually go. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Colombia earthquake rescue crews race to free trapped survivors
item.description: Emergency crews are picking through piles of rubble in hopes of helping trapped survivors after a powerful earthquake shook Colombia, causing buildings to crumble and collapse. CBS News' Bradley Blackburn reports.

item.title: How Trump secretly switched planes in Turkey amid Iran's death threats
item.description: President Trump was forced to secretly switch from Air Force One to a separate military aircraft while leaving a summit in Turkey due to Iran's deadly threats, a U.S. official says. Aaron Navarro reports.

item.title: Crowded GOP race in South Carolina as primary held to replace late Sen. Lindsey Graham
item.description: Primaries are being held in six states on Tuesday. In South Carolina, a crowded field of Republicans is vying to replace the late Sen. Lindsey Graham on the ballot. There are also key races for a Senate seat in Minnesota and governor in Wisconsin. Mark Strassmann reports.

item.title: As Medicare pays less for cataract surgery, doctors turn to moneymaking lasers
item.description: More cataract patients, wanting not only restored but improved vision, are paying extra for their doctors to use a laser when a scalpel would do.

item.title: Rescuers race to find Colombia earthquake survivors as death toll rises
item.description: More than 2,700 people were reported missing on Monday night, after the country was struck by its strongest earthquake on record.

item.title: Trump secretly switched to different plane in Turkey amid Iran threat
item.description: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

item.title: North Carolina GOP chooses replacement candidate for Rep. Chuck Edwards
item.description: State Rep. Jennifer Balkcom will face Jamie Ager on the ballot in November.

item.title: Trump signs order on new recommendations for childhood vaccines
item.description: A new executive order from President Trump calls for spacing out vaccines for children and getting fewer at any given time. CBS News medical correspondent Dr. Celine Gounder explains what parents should know.

item.title: At least 200 major wildfires burn across U.S. and Canada
item.description: Hot and dry conditions are fueling at least 200 major wildfires in the western U.S. and Canada. Meanwhile, images show the scale of destruction in Spokane, Washington, from the fires there last week. Ian Lee reports.

item.title: Omar says federal agent was posted outside monthly meeting in Minneapolis suburb
item.description: Democratic U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar says a Homeland Security Investigations agent was outside her monthly town hall meeting in Richfield, Minnesota, on Thursday.

item.title: Search for survivors after powerful earthquake in Colombia
item.description: Officials say more than 111 people have died and more are missing after a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck Colombia on Monday. There's now an urgent search for survivors. Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: Trump secretly moved in catering truck to new plane in Turkey amid Iran missile threat
item.description: While departing a NATO summit in Turkey last month, a Turkish airport catering truck pulling away from Air Force One was secretly carrying President Trump to a military jet amid a threat from Iran. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Eye Opener: How Trump was secretly moved off Air Force One amid threats from Iran
item.description: There are new details about how President Trump was secretly moved from Air Force One using a catering truck amid threats from Iran. Plus, rescuers search for survivors after a powerful and deadly earthquake struck Colombia. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: Rep. Lauren Boebert's son arrested, accused of sexual exploitation of a child
item.description: Colorado Rep. Lauren Boebert's son, Tyler Boebert, was arrested last weekend on suspicion of sexual exploitation of a child and other charges.

item.title: The Money Conversations Every Couple Needs to Have | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
item.description: Belle Burden's bestselling memoir, Strangers, was framed as a cautionary tale about women left financially vulnerable after divorce, but it omitted a crucial detail: her substantial family wealth. Jill and Mark explore why full financial transparency matters, what couples should understand before signing a prenup, and how to approach essential money conversations before marriage. Plus: they help caller Megan navigate a disagreement with her husband about whether the pair can afford a bigger home.

item.title: Powerball jackpot nears $1 billion after no one won $905 million grand prize
item.description: No winning tickets were sold for Monday night's $905 million Powerball jackpot, so the estimated grand prize for Wednesday night's drawing will be at least $975 million, Powerball says.

item.title: In texts, Fauci discussed potential risks, benefits of COVID vaccine for pregnant women
item.description: Two Senate Republicans released a set of 2021 texts that show Dr. Anthony Fauci discussing how to "weigh the potential risks against the benefits" of pregnant women taking COVID-19 vaccines.

item.title: Captain of boat that capsized in New York facing federal charges after mom, infant die
item.description: Manuel Hernandez, the boat's 46-year-old captain, was arrested on reckless endangerment charges and also charged in federal court with two counts of misconduct and neglect.
